data.name: Vishwajit
data.gender_notes: Vishwajit is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Vishwajit is derived from the Sanskrit words Vishwa, meaning 'world' or 'universe', and Jit, meaning 'conqueror' or 'victor'. This name signifies a person who has conquered the universe or all aspects of life, and is often associated with the deity Vishwakarma, the divine architect and creator of the universe.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a spiritually enlightened individual who has conquered the universe through inner peace and wisdom.
data.etymology: Vishwajit belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Universal Conqueror.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vishwajit total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name Vishwajit carries a rich cultural heritage as it is derived from ancient Sanskrit scriptures. It is used in Hindu culture, especially among Jains and some royal families in India, suggesting a person of impeccable character, strength, and wisdom.
data.spiritual_significance: On a spiritual level, Vishwajit represents the individual's quest for ultimate self-realization and mastery over the inner and outer realms of existence. It evokes the idea of an individual transcending worldly desires and conquering the vastness of the universe through knowledge, wisdom, and moral values. The name also serves as a reminder of the deity Vishwakarma, who, with his divine creative powers, constructed the universe. Thus, Vishwajit symbolizes the divine creator within, inspiring devotion, spiritual growth, and a sense of cosmic connection.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Vishwajit: Radiant conqueror of the universe. One who triumphs over the cosmic expanse.
